title: AI Fairness Beyond Complete Demographics: Current Achievements and Future Directions

bias_targets.methodology: Systematic review and taxonomy of fairness notions (e.g., Rawlsian fairness, proxy fairness, counterfactual fairness) and machine learning techniques (e.g., adversarial learning, reweighting, third-party assessment) used to measure and mitigate outcome disparities when explicit demographic attributes are partially or completely missing.

Surveying existing algorithms, proxy-inference strategies, and benchmark datasets (e.g., CelebA, COMPAS, Adult) used by the field to evaluate and correct disparate model performance across genders in the absence of complete gender data.

Surveying existing algorithms, proxy-inference strategies, and benchmark datasets (e.g., COMPAS, MIMIC-III, Bail) used by the field to evaluate and correct disparate model performance across racial groups in the absence of complete racial data.

Surveying existing algorithms, proxy-inference strategies, and benchmark datasets (e.g., Credit, MIMIC-III, SUPPORT) used by the field to evaluate and correct disparate model performance across age groups in the absence of complete age data.
